verdict.rationale: Avalara documents several AI-generated insight/suggestion features: AI-powered tax code recommendations with confidence levels, AI-assisted explanations of jurisdiction/tax calculation breakdowns, discrepancy detection with correction recommendations, and conversational transaction analysis to spot patterns/anomalies. These directly match 'AI-generated insights and suggestions from data' for an AI-native user. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of these AI features actually working, clarity on whether these are surfaced natively in a UI versus only via MCP/API tool calls for external agents, and depth beyond brief doc snippets.
